channel.title: The ChoiceBoard blog
channel.description: Guides, templates, and comparisons on group decision-making for teams: how to compare options, weigh what matters, surface disagreement, and reach a ranked result you can defend.

item.title: Group decision making process for teams
item.description: Use this group decision making process to define authority, compare options, surface dissent, and record a clear final call your team can explain.

item.title: Decision matrix template for team choices
item.description: Download a decision matrix template, set clear weights, score options consistently, and test how assumptions change a team’s ranked result.

item.title: Pairwise comparison method for team decisions
item.description: The pairwise comparison method evaluates two options at a time. Learn how to compare pairs, count questions, and recognize inconsistent preferences in teams.
